description: Search the text of every loaded script — and every original file recoverable from source maps — for a string or regular expression. This is the fastest way to locate a handler when you know a function name, a message or a field name but not the file. Returns file, 1-based line and the matching line.

context_chars.description: Characters of the matching line to return.

include_original_sources.description: Also search original files from source maps.

query.description: Text or regular expression to find.

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression.

url_filter.description: Only search scripts whose URL contains this.

name: source_search
